_comment: IRSA trust policy for the mcp-approval-gate-executor role — the identity
permissions in deploy/iam/agent-user-inline-policy.json to this same role
(aws iam put-role-policy) rather than to an IAM User.
The executor is the aws-api-mcp-server workload, which runs in the same
`app: aws-api-mcp-server` selector) under the ServiceAccount created by
deploy/k8s/agent-serviceaccount.yaml. The `sub` condition below binds the
role to exactly that ServiceAccount, not the whole cluster.
Replace ACCOUNT_ID and OIDC_PROVIDER (the cluster's OIDC issuer host,
without the leading https://, e.g. oidc.eks.ap-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/XXXX
